title: Thorn Princess
format: Pop-up exhibition, 26 laser-cut letters, up to 6 ft tall
summary: A one-night pop-up exhibition that changes as visitors move through it. Tall letters that look elegant from across the room and turn sharp as you walk closer.
coverAlt: Tall cut letters in a City Hall lobby, with small thorns where the serifs would be

blocks.heading: The idea
blocks.body: Some people are kinder and stronger than they look. These letters work the same way. Small, sharp thorns sit where the serifs would be, and only visitors who come close find them. The visit is the reveal.

blocks.label: Sketches. Pencil drawings of the control letters H and O, and a plan of the lobby.

blocks.heading: Process
blocks.body: I drew the letters by hand, built them digitally, and cut test letters at full height. The thorns were the hard part. Too many and the letters looked angry, too few and nobody noticed them. Walking tests set the rule. Thorns sit only at the ends of strokes, and show only within about six feet.

blocks.caption: The thorn, from too much to just enough.
The exhibition on the night, seen from the entrance.

blocks.heading: Reflection
blocks.body: Light changed everything. Next time I would test one full-size letter under the lobby lights before cutting the rest.
